visible_observation: The layout relies on a rigid, centered vertical stack where the title, subtitle, and footer text are all aligned to the same central axis. The background features a large, faint geometric wireframe (resembling a jellyfish) that is also perfectly centered behind the text.
critique: This creates a 'flat' composition with no spatial tension or visual path. The text acts as a heavy, static block that obscures the background imagery rather than interacting with it. The layout feels like a standard template rather than an atmospheric environment; the text sits 'on top' of the image rather than existing 'within' the deep-sea world. The lack of offset or scale variation makes the hierarchy feel mechanical rather than organic.
revision: Break the central axis by shifting the title 'BELOW THE LAST LIGHT' to the left or right third of the canvas, allowing the background wireframe organism to occupy the center stage. Alternatively, scale the title significantly larger so it bleeds off the edges, creating a sense of immense scale and pressure, while moving the subtitle and footer to the bottom corners to anchor the frame.
protected_strength: The atmospheric gradient and the subtle bioluminescent color palette (teals and reds) effectively establish the deep-sea mood and should be preserved.
